speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Since the jaundice has persisted for two days in a 2-week-old exclusively breastfed infant, I need to assess the severity. Has your baby been passing stool normally, and is she having regular wet diapers? REQUEST TEST: Total_Bilirubin

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Breast Milk Jaundice. The bilirubin level of 16.1 mg/dL in a 2-week-old exclusively breastfed infant with normal weight gain is consistent with this diagnosis, as the jaundice typically peaks after the first week and persists beyond the first two weeks of life.
